protocol.environmentClock: completed real interactions including charged terminal reset
protocol.computationClock: expected row backups; five per S decision; planning consumes no environment tick
protocol.controlObjective: discounted goal-X return for each trip; terminal tail zero
protocol.reportedObjective: raw lifetime reward at fixed 96 additional interaction ticks, reset overhead included
protocol.known: state/action identities, reward convention and terminal reset; observed warmup graph fixes backup order
protocol.hidden: outlet transitions, change schedule and current true phase
protocol.evidence: No random seeds, confidence intervals or external performance claim; exact constructed counterexample.
